tool_input.description: Install dependencies in a scratch directory and smoke-test the login server

tool_input.content:
#!/bin/bash
cd /tmp/login-demo
SESSION_SECRET=test PORT=3987 node server.js > server.log 2>&1 &
PID=$!
sleep 1.5
U=http://localhost:3987
H='content-type: application/json'
GOOD='{"username":"bob","password":"correct horse"}'
BAD='{"username":"bob","password":"wrong-password"}'
code() { curl -s -o /dev/null -w "%{http_code} " -H "$H" "$@"; }
echo -n "register: "; code -d '{"username":"Bob","password":"correct horse"}' $U/register; echo
echo -n "me no session: "; code $U/me; echo
echo -n "login ok: "; code -c jar -d "$GOOD" $U/login; echo
echo -n "me: "; curl -s -b jar $U/me; echo
echo -n "logout then me: "; code -b jar -X POST $U/logout; code -b jar $U/me; echo
echo -n "7 bad logins: "; for i in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7; do code -d "$BAD" $U/login; done; echo
echo -n "good login while locked: "; code -d "$GOOD" $U/login; echo
echo -n "unknown user: "; code -d '{"username":"nobody","password":"wrong-password"}' $U/login; echo
echo -n "no body: "; code -X POST $U/login; echo
kill $PID
cat server.log
